mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising HOUST combined with strong RSAFS signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate profit growth, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both exceed 3-month moving averages during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in INDPRO indicates strong manufacturing output that supports corporate capacity utilization and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 0.50%, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.50%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) signals strong economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% during post-recession recovery.
